title: Step 59-G full verification and browser acceptance
description: Run a final non-feature acceptance layer over Step 59 Home, Navigation and Discovery. Verify that Stage-B through Stage-F deterministic verifiers remain wired into Storefront verify, render a production SSR Home against an authoritative mock GET /products backend, validate navigation/search/discovery/merchandising/handoff behavior as one integrated surface, prove that Step 60/61/65/66 downstream routes remain placeholders, and require the existing Storefront Browser Quality workflow to pass accessibility, keyboard, responsive and 400% reflow gates on the exact PR head. Do not change Home runtime behavior unless a verified acceptance failure requires a separately authorized remediation. Do not update Roadmap or Current State here; canonical state synchronization is reserved for Stage 59-H.

dependencies.name: Home states accessibility and responsive hardening

acceptance_criteria.description: All Step59 stage verifiers B-F remain wired into Storefront verify and final step59:acceptance is also wired without removing inherited quality/auth/state gates.
acceptance_criteria.verification: pnpm --dir apps/storefront step59:acceptance && pnpm --dir apps/storefront verify

acceptance_criteria.description: Integrated SSR Home with authoritative GET /products renders one H1, search entry, category and brand discovery, six bounded product cards with Toman, buying guide and wholesale handoffs, with no unexpected API calls.
Search/Category remain Step60 placeholders; Product remains Step61 placeholder; Wholesale remains Step65 placeholder; Articles remains Step66 placeholder.
No new runtime feature, backend/API/OpenAPI/database/dependency/lockfile mutation is introduced by Stage G; any acceptance defect requires separately authorized remediation before closure.
Exact-head Storefront Browser Quality passes accessibility, keyboard navigation, responsive widths and 400% reflow on the same PR head used by Canonical CI and Phase A.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Storefront Browser Quality + Canonical CI + Phase A exact-head evidence

acceptance_criteria.description: Protected merge and exact-SHA postmerge pnpm verify + Phase A pass before Stage 59-H canonical closure starts.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Stage 59-G is verification-only MEDIUM risk. Direct-main/raw merge are prohibited. Stage 59-H remains blocked until protected merge and exact-SHA postmerge verification pass.
